concepts.name: HTML document
concepts.description: A structured document that defines the content and semantic structure of a web page.

concepts.name: doctype
concepts.description: The declaration that tells the browser which HTML standard the document uses.

concepts.name: head
concepts.description: The part of an HTML document containing metadata, links, scripts, and information not directly rendered as page content.

concepts.name: body
concepts.description: The part of an HTML document containing the visible page content and interactive elements.

concepts.name: Semantic element
concepts.description: An HTML element whose tag name communicates the meaning or role of its content.

concepts.name: Heading hierarchy
concepts.description: The ordered structure of headings that communicates page organization and content levels.

concepts.name: Anchor element
concepts.description: The HTML element used to create links to pages, resources, sections, or actions.

concepts.name: href
concepts.description: The attribute that specifies the destination of a link.

concepts.name: Image element
concepts.description: The HTML element used to embed an image in a page.

concepts.name: alt text
concepts.description: Text that describes an image for users who cannot see it or when the image fails to load.

concepts.name: Text content
concepts.description: The readable words and characters presented in a document or interface.

concepts.name: Media asset
concepts.description: A file such as an image, audio clip, video, or font used by a web page.

concepts.name: Ordered list
concepts.description: An HTML list where item order matters and is usually shown with numbers or letters.

concepts.name: Unordered list
concepts.description: An HTML list where item order does not matter and is usually shown with bullets.

concepts.name: Table header
concepts.description: A table cell that labels a row or column and helps define table meaning.

concepts.name: Table row
concepts.description: A horizontal group of cells in an HTML table.

concepts.name: Accessible structure
concepts.description: Markup organized so assistive technologies can understand roles, relationships, and navigation.

concepts.name: Screen reader navigation
concepts.description: How screen reader users move through headings, landmarks, links, forms, and other page structures.

concepts.name: Form element
concepts.description: The HTML element that groups controls for collecting and submitting user input.

concepts.name: Input element
concepts.description: A form control that accepts user-entered data such as text, numbers, dates, or selections.

concepts.name: Label
concepts.description: Text associated with a form control to identify what input is expected.

concepts.name: Form submission
concepts.description: The process of sending collected form data for handling or processing.

concepts.name: Client-side validation
concepts.description: Input checking performed in the browser before data is submitted to a server.

concepts.name: Required field
concepts.description: A form control that must be filled in before submission can proceed.
